attempts.note: Generic client: the target API is whatever configuration.baseUrl names, so no vendor spec can exist. Surface read from src/Adaptor.js, src/util.js and configuration-schema.json.

notes: The http adaptor (7.3.3) talks to no particular system: request(method, path), get, post, put, patch and del send any of GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE (request() also allows others such as HEAD) to {baseUrl}/{path} with Basic or Bearer auth. "Full" therefore means the adaptor's operation surface, not a vendor API: each method is modelled at a collection-level (/{resource}) and an item-level (/{resource}/{id}) template with an open Resource schema, which replaces the July stub's invented literal /resources paths and its localhost server. parseXML and the 25 common re-exports make no request and are enumerated in info.x-openfn-local-operations instead of being turned into fake endpoints. Limits: OpenAPI 3.0 has no multi-segment path wildcard, so a deeper path (a/b/c) matches neither template, and the response schemas say nothing about any real API.
